title: Contract approval path optimizer + security-questionnaire integrated playbook
creator: Asha Menon
description: Background: Enterprise sales consistently request bespoke indemnity and liability concessions tied to pricing. Legal review plus security questionnaire (SQ) responses both affect approval path and SLA, but current flows are manual, siloed, and slow. We want a single playbook that combines SQ risk signals with contract redline scoring to automate tiered pricing exceptions and speed up approvals for low-risk cases.
objective: Create a deterministic approval path optimizer that uses security questionnaire answers and contract clause scoring to surface an automated recommendation (auto-approve / needs-legal / escalate-to-sales-lead) and attach pricing concession templates when appropriate. Run a controlled pricing/packaging experiment to measure time-to-close and concession spend.
scope: In-scope: design approval decision rules mapping SQ risk bands to price concession tiers
In-scope: telemetry events and dashboard for concession spend by cohort
In-scope: UI for sales to view automated recommendation and 'override with justification'
In-scope: playbook doc for legal reviewers to handle escalations
Out-of-scope: wholesale changes to MSA language (handled by separate legal project)
Out-of-scope: backend migration to new contracts store (ENG-41234 only provides API hooks)
Out-of-scope: changes to product pricing engine (pricing engine experiments will consume our signals)
acceptance_criteria: Decision engine returns recommendation within 2s for 95% of requests
SQ + redline score mapping documented and approved by Legal and Security
Dashboard shows concession spend, # of auto-approved deals, and avg time-to-contract; baseline/experiment cohorts available
Sales UI shows recommendation and audit log; override mechanism attaches justification and routes for manual legal review
Run initial 6-week experiment with two cohorts: control (manual) and treatment (automated recommendations); results captured in experiment dashboard
success_metrics: Reduce median time from redline submission to final signature by 30% in treatment cohort
Reduce legal hours spent on low-risk redlines by 40%
Auto-approve rate for low-risk SQ cohort >= 60% without regression in post-signature incidents
Concession spend per deal does not increase >10% relative to control cohort
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Automated rules could under-estimate risk, leading to compliance exposure. Mitigation: conservative initial thresholds and weekly legal/security review of auto-approved sample.

Risk: Sales overrides may be abused to bypass controls. Mitigation: require mandatory justification with structured fields and quota-based penalty monitoring; add audit alerts for high-frequency overrides.
Risk: SQ data quality is inconsistent. Mitigation: add data validation steps and fall back to manual review when key SQ sections are missing.
Risk: Experiment could distort pricing if cohort selection biased. Mitigation: randomize assignment at contract intake; stratify by ARR and industry
implementation_plan: Week 1-2: Define risk bands and redline clause scoring rubric with Legal + Security; produce canonical mapping doc
Week 3-4: Build lightweight decision service (ENG contract-advisor API) to ingest SQ responses + clause score and return recommendation
Week 4-6: Integrate decision response into Sales Console UI with override flow and logs; instrument telemetry events
Week 6-8: Launch 6-week experiment for deals under $100k ARR; monitor experiment dashboard daily
Week 9: Review experiment with Legal, Security, and Revenue Ops; decide production rollout or adjustments
